items.title: I had to assemble this laptop. Then I  installed #omarchy on it.
items.summary:
I had to assemble this laptop. Then I installed #omarchy on it. 

Thanks to @frameworkcomputer for sending me one!! Not sponsored, no strings attached. They didn’t know I was making this short.
items.author: NetworkChuck
items.transcript: This is the strangest and also most awesome laptop I've ever received. Let's unbox it. Now, first thing you'll notice is that it comes in pieces. It is not put together. Assembly required. So, our goal here is to assemble it and then install Linux on it. Omachi Arch, by the way, and see how fast it installs because apparently you can install Omachi in under 60 seconds. Now, there's QR codes everywhere with how to do this. I've done this before. I've replaced an HDD with an SSD. Yes, that's how old I am. I can do this. And at first, I was doing okay. I installed the hard drive. NVME flash drive. Done. But then what the junk is this? This is their RAM. I've never seen RAM like this before. You're supposed to be able to slot it in. There's no slot. You just lay it flat. What is this? It's called CAM 2 or the compression attached memory module. Kind of freaking me out. I don't know if I installed this right. just go with it. I really hope this works. [music] Then we had to install the keyboard and then the bezel, which has that retro kind of Game Boy see-through '90s feel. Love it. Now, check this out. This laptop is modular. And in case you didn't notice, it's a Framework laptop. They're known for this. And thank you, Framework, for sending me this laptop. So, notice where I would normally have like USBC ports and HDMI ports. I just have slots where I can slot in an HDMI port if I want it to be like that. Slot in a USBC port if I want it there. I choose. I can go get more modules. I can have it all USBC or all HDMI if I want that. That'd [music] be kind of weird. But it's more of my computer. That's kind of the theme here. Now, time to see if this thing works. But it doesn't come with an OS. Power it on. No OS. [music] I have to bring the OS. And we're not doing Windows here. No, no, no. We're doing Linux. [music] Omachi Quattro. So, I flashed my USB drive, plugged that sucker in, and ran [music] into issues immediately. It's not seeing anything on that USB drive to boot. So, I reflashed the USB and figured out it was my fault. I didn't realize that framework comes [music] preconfigured with secure boot. Turning off secure boot. Boom. Omachi Quattro is there. Now, let's see how fast we can install this. Ready, set, go. Boom. Under 60 seconds. I mean, we're at the line. I got it installed. It's awesome. Here's the fast fetch on that sucker. This thing's fast. Uh, battery life's amazing. This might be my new favorite laptop. Oh, also check this out. Hardware switches for the camera and the microphone. This is my new favorite laptop. [music] Morpheus here. Chuck didn't realize the screen was a touch
